title: Replicate delayed gratification under the original metric
frozenQuestion: Can the paper's delayed-gratification statistic and Figures 6-7 be reconstructed from declared swap-state trajectories without changing the formula after outcomes are observed?

evidenceReconciliation.frozenPublicCommit: The function avg_wandering_range in analysis/delay_gratification_analysis_for_not_move.py at commit 1fd2bd5921c1f6b423a71f691d5189106a8a1020 implements the journal net formula after plateau removal and signed-run merging, with an early terminal return that can return an accumulated sum rather than an average.
evidenceReconciliation.s03Decision: Preserve the commit-aligned net formula as historical_dg_net and retain recovery/worsening as a named sensitivity; S12 must freeze segmentation and edge cases.
evidenceReconciliation.priorityDecision: historical_dg_net_commit_exact_v1 is the primary publication-replication score because it preserves the frozen public function exactly. historical_dg_net_s03_reconciled_v1 and arxiv_recovery_ratio_v1 are sensitivity scores and may not replace the primary after results are inspected.

trajectoryContract.stateSampling: Record monotonicity error immediately after every accepted swap. Do not record the initial state and do not record activations, no-ops, rejections, or memory-only updates. This matches the frozen cell-view StatusProbe record_sorting_step call site.
trajectoryContract.monotonicityError: Count strict adjacent inversions right<left. For the unique-value S12 populations, paper Sortedness count equals n-monotonicityError, so worsening/recovery magnitudes are identical with reversed signs.
trajectoryContract.terminalState: The terminal state is present only if produced by an accepted swap; no synthetic terminal observation is appended.
trajectoryContract.emptyTrajectory: Return zero for all DG scores and zero usable pairs.
trajectoryContract.traceIdentity: Hash the canonical post-swap monotonicity-error sequence and bind it to scenarioId, transition semantics, sampling profile, and stop reason.

primaryMetric.name: historical_dg_net_commit_exact_v1
steps: Take adjacent differences and merge consecutive differences having the same strict sign.
Find the first positive signed run; discard all preceding improving runs.
Pair each positive worsening run w with its immediately following negative recovery run -r.
For each complete pair compute q=(r-w)/w; retain negative, zero, and positive q values.
Accumulate q values exactly as the frozen function does.
If no first complete pair exists, return zero.
If the loop encounters an unmatched terminal worsening run or an unexpected positive follower, return the accumulated sum immediately, including zero when no pair was accumulated.
If all pairs are complete, return the arithmetic mean of q over complete pairs.
primaryMetric.zeroDenominatorRule: Impossible for a usable pair because w is selected only from a strictly positive signed run; any nonpositive candidate is not a denominator.
primaryMetric.plateauRule: Consecutive plateaus are removed before differences and therefore do not form segments.
primaryMetric.terminalDropRule: Preserve the frozen early-return behavior and flag terminalEarlyReturn=true.
primaryMetric.aggregation: Every declared run contributes one scalar, including zero. Figure 7 bars are arithmetic means over exactly 100 paper-scale runs with population SD ddof=0 as a historical reconstruction only.

sensitivityMetrics.historical_dg_net_s03_reconciled_v1: Use the same complete pairs and q values but ignore an unmatched terminal worsening run and always average complete pairs; return zero if none.
sensitivityMetrics.arxiv_recovery_ratio_v1: Use the same complete pairs, compute r/w, average complete pairs, ignore unmatched terminal worsening, and return zero if none.
sensitivityMetrics.initialStateIncluded: Recompute the three scores after prepending the initial monotonicity error; label this sampling sensitivity and never use it as the primary Figure 7 reconstruction.

figure6AmbiguityEnvelope.input: all 720 identity permutations of values 1..6 with value 4 stuck
figure6AmbiguityEnvelope.role: Exhaustive clean-room ambiguity envelope, not a recovered historical stream or proof of the publication algorithm/input.

figure6Rules.claimBoundary: A temporary drop followed by recovery is a trajectory fact; a positive normalized-net DG score additionally requires recovery beyond the drop magnitude. Neither establishes foresight.

analysis.panelMeanReproduced: Generated primary mean rounded to two decimals equals the registered paper mean rounded to two decimals.
analysis.panelMeanApproximatelyReproduced: If not reproduced, absolute difference is at most max(0.05, 0.10*abs(paperMean)) and the applicable direction/rank is not reversed.
analysis.architectureContrasts: For each policy, pool f=0..3 under the historical-primary placement and compute paired cell_view-traditional mean differences by pairingBlockId. Use 10000 deterministic paired-bootstrap resamples and report 95% intervals; historical z values remain targets only.
analysis.faultCountTrends: For each architecture-policy-placement profile, report all four means, monotone nondecreasing status, and paired f3-f0 mean difference with a deterministic 10000-resample interval. Bubble and Insertion are expected to increase; Selection is expected to lack a clear monotone trend.
analysis.multiplicity: Trend intervals use Bonferroni-adjusted 99.1666667% confidence over six architecture-policy trend claims within each placement profile. Architecture-contrast intervals are descriptive 95% intervals because the registered paper z-test construction is unavailable.
analysis.noPostHocChanges: Formula, segmentation, state sampling, populations, pairing, margins, and trend criteria are immutable after this file is written. Any implementation defect must be corrected transparently without changing the scientific rule.

validation.handFixtures: At least eight independently hand-calculated edge cases, including the Figure 6 sequence, plateaus, no drop, no recovery, negative net, multiple pairs, and terminal early return.
validation.frozenCodeComparison: AST-extract only the necessary pure functions from the immutable quarantined file and require exact agreement on all fixtures plus at least 1000 seeded randomized integer trajectories; do not import or redistribute the full original module.
validation.replay: At least 24 selected scenarios must replay byte-exactly at the DG-result and trajectory-hash level; selected ordinary engine event replay must agree with the optimized trajectory path.
validation.accounting: Require 4200/4200 Figure 7 and 2160/2160 Figure 6 runs, no forbidden split, all scenario identities rematerialized exactly, all trajectories bound to stop reasons, and all reported means recomputed from canonical rows.
validation.sourceIntegrity: Verify all 91 frozen public-source checksums before and after S12.
validation.failureCriterion: Zero unexplained validation failures. Missing historical data remain explicit rather than being replaced by regenerated data.

claimBoundaries: DG is a paper-defined trajectory proxy, not Experiment 3 global distance.
A positive or context-varying DG score is not evidence of planning, anticipation, or foresight.
Frozen public HEAD is a nondeterministic comparator and analysis-evidence source, not the identified publication snapshot.
Regenerated trajectories are clean-room evidence and never historical raw data.
